name: Prime Selector
description:
Add a GPU Quick Settings tile to switch NVIDIA PRIME profiles.

Maps prime-select modes to short labels:
* Integrated (intel)
* Dedicated (nvidia)
* Optimus (on-demand)

Requires nvidia-prime (prime-select) and pkexec. Switching profiles runs `pkexec prime-select <profile>` and usually needs a logout or reboot to apply.
